scope: Phase 8t re-run targeted at GATA1/MYC/TAL1 with responding-feature IDs saved
interpretation: See specificity_with_null.csv for full results. The is_specific column at each threshold reports whether ≥1 responding feature has ≥threshold of its top-20 in the TF's target set. The p_null_specific_>=1 column gives the probability of this happening by random feature draw at the same K. A meaningful 'specific' verdict requires is_specific=True AND n_specific significantly exceeds null_mean.
